name: pool+4: refcount or first array slot?
question: sub_00211280 decrements a refcount at MEM32(obj+4) where obj resolves to the pool 0x011CE000; sub_00205170 reads the same 4 bytes as the first deferred-free array slot and then dereferences the value. Which reading is wrong? (ledger #60)

variants.hypothesis: esi+0xB0 wrongly holds the POOL, so the refcount decrement is landing on an object it should never touch. Suppressing that one write should stop the array being corrupted and let the walk finish.

The pool legitimately carries a refcount at +4, so the deferred-free array starts at +8 and sub_00205170's base is off by one slot. Shifting the cursor should skip the refcount and walk only real entries.
